notes.title: 0.3 UPDATE ANNOUNCEMENT
notes.content:
[olist]
[*] Added NPCs, the Patron Saint of Nature and Ban Xia
[*] Added story plot, telling a thought-provoking story
[*] New quest system, adding 26 main quests and 8 side quests
[*] New store function, you can sell all the things you don’t need, buy some potions, etc.
[*] Added Blueprint function, you can create a variety of luxury houses with one click
[*] Added room function, you can build houses for the NPCs
[*] Reworked the tree-cutting function, the tree will now collapse when being felled
[*] Added dozens of new blocks, including modern lights, stairs and steps
[*] New BOSS big blood bar
[*] Redo some textures and particle effects
[*] Optimize the game window, now you can zoom in and out freely
[*] Increase the probability of mineral generation
[*] Adjust part of the synthesis formula
[*] Optimize some functions
[*] Fix known issues
[/olist]

notes.title: v0.2.1 UPDATE LOG
notes.content:
[olist]
[*] When weapons are made and dropped, they will have a random quality between Normal, Uncommon, Rare, and Epic
[*] The weapon will have a random attack speed when it is made and dropped
[*] Uncommon, Rare and Epic weapons will increase attack speed and damage
[*] Jian Qi has been added to melee weapons
[*] Legendary and Only weapon comes with Jian Qi. Uncommon, Rare and Epic weapons have a certain chance to carry Jian Qi
[*] Additional Properties and Suit Properties have been added to the equipment, and the properties of some suits have been redesigned to distinguish the three types of suits: Melee, Ranged and Magic
[*] Now Wildkin will drop Tadashi Youtomura
[/olist]

notes.title: v0.2 UPDATE LOG
notes.content:
[h2]This update is mainly to redo the world generation[/h2]

[olist]
[*] Redo the world generation algorithm, now the world is randomly generated and infinite
[*] Reworked the ecological generation algorithm, and now there is a better transition between ecological systems
[*] Reworked the terrain algorithm, now the world has better terrain, mountains, plains, rivers, swamps, oceans, caves, canyons, etc.
[*] Reworked the lighting system, now the world has more realistic diffuse lighting
[*] Redo the textures of almost all blocks, redo or modify the appearance of some model blocks
[*] Added a water block, it will move more slowly underwater and will drown underwater for a long time
[*] Optimize monster behavior and adjust some monster attributes
[*] Now the gold coins will fall to the ground when the monster dies, and there is a chance to drop the Heart of Recovery, which will restore a little health when picked up
[*] Hard mode increases the drop rate of rare items and more gold coins
[*] Enhance the sense of weapon strikes, enhance attack special effects, and optimize character animation
[*] Random affixes are added to weapons when they are manufactured
[*] Weapon durability will now be displayed on the icon
[*] Added modern doors, desk lamps and floor lamps
[*] Placing blocks now have special effects and animations
[*] Increase the damage of the third blow of the great sword
[*] Since the flash of the staff is too powerful, the flash of the staff now costs mana
[*] Equipment that can be dyed now also changes color
[*] Modify the synthesis formula of some items
[*] Optimize some UI
[*] Temporarily remove the minimap function
[*] Some other optimizations
[/olist]
